basics.name: Junteng Liu
basics.summary: First-year PhD candidate in the HKUST NLP Group at the Hong Kong University of Science and Technology, supervised by Professor Junxian He. Research combines natural language processing and machine learning, focused on LLM reasoning and reinforcement learning, hallucination in vision-language models, and LLM truthfulness and interpretability.

work.name: Research Intern
work.summary: Research internship at Tencent WXG, June 2024 - September 2024. Supervisor: Zifei Shan.
